i.norm:
Verifies that the edit script produced by {@link SequencesComparator} actually transforms the "before" sequence into the "after" sequence.

For every (before, after) pair the test:

  1. builds the edit script that turns {@code before} into {@code after},
  2. replays that script through an {@link ExecutionVisitor} seeded with {@code before},
  3. asserts that the visitor's resulting string equals {@code after}.

Replays an {@link EditScript} onto a starting sequence and exposes the resulting sequence as a string. The script's commands are applied in order: keep advances past an element, insert adds an element from the target, and delete removes an element from the source. @param <T> the element type of the sequences being compared
The working sequence, mutated as commands are visited.
